core: Heart morphogenesis and mesoderm development regulation
name: Mesoderm and heart morphogenesis regulation, coronary vasculature and pericardium
rationale: All members concern mesoderm-derived heart formation; coronary vasculogenesis, cardiac vascular smooth muscle and pericardium distinguish it from second-heart-field, ventricular/endocardial and gastrulation neighbours.

name: NT-3/NTRK3 signaling and Trk adaptor-driven Ras activation
rationale: Members are NTF3-activated NTRK3 outputs (RAS, PLCG1, PI3K) plus ARMS- and FRS2-mediated Ras activation, separating it from NTRK2, NGF/TRKA and MAP2K/RIT neighbours.

qualifier: COPI-coated, retrograde and intra-Golgi, with vesicle tethering
name: COPI vesicle trafficking and Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic and Golgi vesicle targeting/tethering, distinguishing it from COPII ER-export and Rab/ARF signaling neighbours.

qualifier: phosphatidylglycerol, cardiolipin and phosphatidylcholine via CDP intermediates
name: Phosphatidylglycerol, cardiolipin and phosphatidylcholine synthesis via CDP intermediates
rationale: All members are CDP-DAG/CDP-choline routes to PG, cardiolipin and PC, including PG/CL remodeling, unlike neighbours centred on PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or other phospholipid remodeling and hydrolysis.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate sanitization
name: De novo purine synthesis and nucleotide pool sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine (azathioprine/TPMT) handling, distinguishing it from purine salvage/catabolism and antiviral nucleoside drug neighbours.

qualifier: elastic fibre and collagen fibril assembly and regulation
name: Elastic fibre and collagen fibril formation and regulation
rationale: Members cover elastic fibre assembly, collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and fibril organization and their regulation, unlike neighbours focused on MMP-driven collagen degradation or basement membrane/anchoring fibrils.

qualifier: respiration regulation, ferroptosis and intrinsic apoptosis
name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress cell death and respiration regulation
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, NO, ischemia and hypoxia, control of mitochondrial respiration/ATP synthesis, and ferroptotic and intrinsic apoptotic death, distinguishing it from ROS-detoxification and osmotic/drug-response neighbours.

qualifier: O-fucose/O-glucose on Notch and TSR domains
name: O-fucosylation and O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR domains
rationale: All members concern O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch EGF repeats and thrombospondin repeats (including B3GALTL/Peters-plus) and its effect on Notch, unlike N-glycosylation, heparan sulfate and Hedgehog lipidation neighbours.

qualifier: CREB and MECP2 via PKA and CaMK
name: Activity-dependent CREB and MECP2 neuronal transcription via PKA/CaMK
rationale: Members link cAMP/PKA and CaMKII/IV signaling to CREB phosphorylation, MECP2 and NPAS4 regulation and long-term memory, distinguishing it from synaptic plasticity, MECP2-HDAC and dopamine-cAMP neighbours.

qualifier: ERBB4/ERBB3 receptors via SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K
name: ERBB4- and ERBB3-centred signaling through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K
rationale: Members are ERBB3, ERBB4 and ERBB2-ERBB4 signaling and their SHC1/GRB2/PI3K adaptor events, unlike EGFR-centred, ERBB2-motility and ERBB4 nuclear/downregulation neighbours.

qualifier: global-genome and transcription-coupled incision of UV damage
name: Global and transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair of UV damage
rationale: Members cover damage recognition, incision complex formation and dual incision in GG-NER and TC-NER of pyrimidine dimers, distinguishing it from translesion synthesis and GG-NER gap-filling neighbours.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT-regulated FOXO stress transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT/acetylation control of FOXO-driven death and stress genes, with neuronal apoptosis, distinguishing it from ER-stress UPR, p53/mTORC1 metabolic and NFE2L2 degradation neighbours.

name: Pyrimidine de novo synthesis and (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo pyrimidine and UDP/UTP synthesis with catabolism of pyrimidine bases and deoxynucleotides, distinguishing it from pyrimidine salvage/dNTP synthesis and purine-focused neighbours.

name: Misfolded protein quality control by selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded or aggregated proteins via aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and ERAD regulation, distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, proteasomal and stress-granule neighbours.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels, acid sensing and sour taste
rationale: Members are K2P channel families setting resting potential plus acidic-pH responses, TRP channels and sour taste, distinguishing it from pain/thermosensation and Ca2+- or ATP-sensitive K+ channel neighbours.

core: Focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly
name: Fibronectin-syndecan adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly
rationale: Members cover fibronectin matrix and syndecan interactions, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly and fibroblast migration, distinguishing it from RHO-ROCK/PAK and MET/integrin cell-spreading neighbours.

name: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes, organelle size control
rationale: Members are fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, phagosomes and MVBs with lysosomes, autophagosome assembly/maturation regulation and endolysosome size, distinguishing it from selective-autophagy and ESCRT neighbours.

qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange, phosphocreatine and NAD
name: Adenine nucleotide translocation, phosphotransfer and NAD metabolism
rationale: Members span mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and permeabilization, nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, creatine/phosphocreatine and NAD/nicotinate metabolism, distinguishing it from nucleoside transport, CoA synthesis and pyrophosphate neighbours.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hh and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipid-modified Hh/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members combine SMO/GLI Hedgehog signaling with autoprocessing, palmitoylation and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, distinguishing it from prenylation, DVL/TCF and non-canonical Wnt neighbours.

qualifier: proliferation, survival and invasion rather than pigmentation
name: MITF-M transcriptional programs in melanocyte proliferation and survival
rationale: Members are MITF-M regulation and its non-pigmentation target programs plus melanocyte proliferation/differentiation, distinguishing it from melanin synthesis and UV-response neighbours.

name: Uracil and cytosine nucleotide catabolism and UMP salvage
rationale: Members are pyrimidine base catabolism, UMP/dUMP/CMP/dCMP metabolism and UMP salvage, lacking the deoxyribonucleoside and dGMP/dTMP catabolism of its neighbours.

name: De novo nucleotide synthesis and folate one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members are de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis plus folate/tetrahydrofolate interconversion supplying one-carbon units, distinguishing it from salvage, catabolism and interconversion neighbours.

core: Chromatin remodeling at damaged and replicating DNA
name: Nucleosome remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at damaged and replicating DNA
rationale: Members cover nucleosome assembly/disassembly, CHD remodelers, ADP-ribosylation control and protein recruitment at DNA breaks and forks, distinguishing it from R-loop, crosslink-repair and DNA topology neighbours.

name: Germinal centre B cell activation with Tfh co-stimulation
rationale: Members are B cell activation, proliferation and germinal centre/memory differentiation with ICOS, CD27 and Tfh help, distinguishing it from B-1, naive B cell and immune-memory neighbours.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling and NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling with NK cell differentiation/proliferation, distinguishing it from TCR, IL-10/IL-12 family and IL-6/IL-3 family neighbours.
